title: Cited registry entries are named after their strategy and open the strategy page
operator_approval: 2026-11-26 conversation 52a1dacf (answer 都加): scope extended with ports/research_knowledge_source.py, management_read_models/service.py and ports/read_surface_ports.py; research/service.py not approved and not touched.
hosted_verification_note: No VM or SSH access; no operator keys read. Functional evidence only, from the hosted facts in the task brief (hosted 8d506640a: 126 of the first 500 cited references are registry_entry reg-strategy-spec-persona-*, cited 255 times by approvals of decision_type registry_entry; GET /bff/artifacts/<reg-strategy-spec-*> answers 404) and the recorded Registry shapes (services/registry/paper_strategy_spec.py build_registry_entry, artifact_type strategy_spec). Hosted verification belongs to the operator acceptance task.
root_cause: An owner ref {ref_type: registry_entry, ref_id: reg-strategy-spec-*} parses to ref_kind registry_entry, which cited_evidence.py neither read, named nor linked. The only bounded Registry read wired in (read_registry_strategy_artifact_detail) filters to artifact_type execution_bundle and answers (None, 'ok') for strategy_spec entries (same filter behind the GET /bff/artifacts 404), so it could never answer their strategy_id.
acceptance_as_delivered: 1. New bounded owner read DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort.read_registry_entry_strategy (GET /api/registry/entries/{id} through the existing _registry_http_get: caller Authorization + X-Tenant-Id, 5 s timeout) answers any artifact_type and projects only registry_id, artifact_type, strategy_id, tenant_id, owner_tenant. ReadSurfacePorts.read_registry_entry_strategy delegates to it; ManagementReadModelService.get_cited_evidence passes it to compose_cited_evidence as registry_entry_reader. Reads run once per distinct registry_entry id on the visible page, in the same wanted list, executor, MAX_ITEM_READS (20) budget and read deadline as artifact and evidence item reads. The answer is validated by the existing _artifact_strategy (status, other tenant / owner_tenant, id mismatch). label = names.strategy(recorded strategy_id); label_parts = {registry_id, strategy_id}. test_registry_entry_named_by_recorded_strategy_and_links_to_strategy (entry cited twice -> one read; caller tenant header asserted).

2. route_href / resolved_link = /management/strategies/{strategy_id} only when the Registry answered a strategy_id, else null; the row never contains /management/artifacts/ (asserted on the serialized row). test_registry_entry_without_recorded_strategy_has_no_name_and_no_link covers strategy_id null and owner 404.

3. An approval citation whose target_id is the entry carries parts.target_display_name when the same read answered a named strategy (test 1, both approvals). Failed (503), slow (past deadline), other-tenant and over-budget reads keep label = ref_id, name_missing true, strategy_id null, route null, no target_display_name; failed/slow are counted in meta.item_reads.failed: test_failed_registry_entry_read_keeps_ref_id_and_is_counted, test_slow_registry_entry_read_is_abandoned_and_counted, test_registry_entry_of_another_tenant_is_never_used, test_registry_entry_reads_share_the_item_read_cap. BFF_API_CONTRACT.md states the rule (new BFF-EVIDENCE-CITED-REG-ENTRY-NAMES-20261126 bullet; budget and target_display_name bullets updated).
unchanged_behaviour: read_registry_strategy_artifact_detail and GET /bff/artifacts are unchanged: test_port_entry_reader_answers_strategy_spec_detail_reader_unchanged asserts the detail reader still answers (None, 'ok') for the strategy_spec entry while the new reader answers its strategy_id.

registry_artifact / member_virtual_book rows (artifact-* ids, including {ref_type: registry_entry, ref_id: artifact-*}) still use artifact_reader and link to /management/artifacts/{artifact}; all pre-existing tests in test_cited_evidence_list.py pass unmodified.

implementation.services/control-plane/bff/ports/researc: _registry_entry_identity helper; abstract ResearchKnowledgeSourcePort.read_registry_entry_strategy; DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort.read_registry_entry_strategy (injected-store and HTTP paths; 404/403 -> (None,'ok'), other non-200 -> (None,'failed'), no base url -> (None,'unconfigured')).
implementation.services/control-plane/bff/management_re: registry_entry_reader parameter; 'entry' read kind in the shared budget; entry_strategies; _name_for/_route_for/_SOURCE_CLASS for registry_entry; _strategy_href; approval target names include answered entries; module docstring.

cost_per_request: At most one extra Registry GET per distinct registry_entry id on the visible page, inside the existing 20-read cap (never additional to it); no new store, writer, index or cache.

residual_findings: The strategy_id value in the fixture (strategy-carry-spec-recorded-0007) is chosen to be non-derivable from the entry id; the brief did not record the hosted strategy_id value. Whether hosted reg-strategy-spec-persona-* entries carry a strategy_id that the strategy label directory names must be confirmed in hosted acceptance; if not, rows stay label = ref_id with route null by design.
research/service.py (ResearchPort aggregator) has no read_registry_entry_strategy; out of approved scope. The management store wired in get_cited_evidence is ReadSurfacePorts, which has it.
